images.caption: Figure 1:Foresight Forcing (ℱ2\mathcal{F}^{2}) at a glance.ℱ2\mathcal{F}^{2}learns spatial transition queries from correspondence-aligned changes in 3D teacher features. During training, a frozen VGGT extracts features from paired observations to supervise the queries. At inference, the queries are predicted from the current observation, instruction, and proprioceptive state and, together with current visual features, condition action generation without the teacher or future observations.

Figure 2:ℱ2\mathcal{F}^{2}architecture.A frozen VGGT provides feature transition targets on the student grid for spatial queries that condition the Action Expert. Insets show the shared updater and spatial query layout. VGGT and future observations are used only during training.
Figure 5:Attention routing on randomized RoboTwin tasks.Positive-gradient rollout for the first action’s left-gripper output at the final denoising step.
Figure 6:Real-world tasks.Representative front-view frames from the six evaluation tasks.
